c1-emlekezetpolitika-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Memorial on Szabadság tér
c1-emlekezetpolitika-01.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what happened on Szabadság tér in 2014.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-01.prompt: Put the events in order, and say how the government and its critics judged the memorial.
cues: Say what followed the start of construction
Name the source of each view
c1-emlekezetpolitika-01.target: Miután 2014 elején ismertté vált a terv, tiltakozások kezdődtek. A kormány szerint az emlékmű a megszállás áldozataira emlékezett, a bírálók szerint viszont elfedte a magyar hatóságok felelősségét.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-01.english: After the plan became known in early 2014, protests began. According to the government the memorial commemorated the victims of the occupation; according to the critics, however, it concealed the responsibility of the Hungarian authorities.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-01.canDo: I can put the events around the memorial on Szabadság tér in 2014 in order with *miután* and *mielőtt* (*emlékmű, megszállás, áldozat*).

c1-emlekezetpolitika-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The House of Terror Museum
c1-emlekezetpolitika-02.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked about the House of Terror Museum.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-02.prompt: Say when the museum opened and how its defenders and its critics judged the exhibition, naming the source.
cues: Give the date of the opening
Name the source of each view
c1-emlekezetpolitika-02.target: A Terror Háza Múzeum 2002. február 24-én nyílt meg. A múzeum védői szerint a kiállítás két diktatúra áldozatainak adott emléket, a bírálók szerint viszont a hangsúly a kommunista korszakon volt.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-02.english: The House of Terror Museum opened on 24 February 2002. According to the museum's defenders the exhibition commemorated the victims of two dictatorships; according to the critics, however, the emphasis was on the communist period.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-02.canDo: I can say when and where the House of Terror Museum opened and what its exhibition covered (*közalapítvány, főigazgató, diktatúra*).

c1-emlekezetpolitika-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Nagy Imre
c1-emlekezetpolitika-03.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked about the fate of Nagy Imre.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-03.prompt: Say when Nagy Imre was executed and when the executed prime minister was reburied.
cues: Give the date of the execution
Give the date of the reburial
c1-emlekezetpolitika-03.target: Nagy Imre miniszterelnököt 1958. június 16-án kivégezték. A kivégzett miniszterelnököt 1989. június 16-án újratemették.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-03.english: Prime minister Nagy Imre was executed on 16 June 1958. The executed prime minister was reburied on 16 June 1989.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-03.canDo: I can give the main dates of the revolution of 1956 and of the reburial of Nagy Imre (*forradalom, szabadságharc, újratemetés*).

c1-emlekezetpolitika-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Horthy Miklós
c1-emlekezetpolitika-04.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how Horthy Miklós has been judged.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-04.prompt: Say how Horthy's supporters and how his critics judged him, setting the two views against each other.
cues: Give the view of the supporters
Give the view of the critics
c1-emlekezetpolitika-04.target: Horthy támogatói szerint a kormányzó a konszolidáció jelképe volt. A bírálók szerint viszont felelősséget viselt a zsidóellenes törvényekért.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-04.english: According to Horthy's supporters the regent was a symbol of consolidation. According to the critics, however, he bore responsibility for the anti-Jewish laws.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-04.canDo: I can give the main dates of Horthy's governorship, from 1920 to 1944 (*kormányzó, fegyverszünet, lemondás*).

c1-emlekezetpolitika-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Open Questions and the Election
c1-emlekezetpolitika-05.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked what was left open and how the period ended.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-05.prompt: Name one open question of memory politics and give the result of the election of 12 April 2026.
cues: State one question that was disputed
Give the result of the election
c1-emlekezetpolitika-05.target: Vitatott volt, hogy kell-e a két diktatúrát egy kiállításon bemutatni. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt a 199 mandátumból 141-et szerzett.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-05.english: It was disputed whether the two dictatorships should be shown in one exhibition. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza Party won 141 of the 199 seats.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-05.canDo: I can state the open questions of memory politics before the election of 2026 (*vitatott, mérték, nyitott kérdés*).

c1-emlekezetpolitika-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Period in Summary
c1-emlekezetpolitika-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the period.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the period briefly, with years and sources.
cues: Mention the memorial on Szabadság tér
Say how it was judged
Mention the election of 2026
c1-emlekezetpolitika-consolidation.target: 2014 júliusában felállították a Szabadság téri emlékművet. A kormány szerint az emlékmű a megszállás áldozataira emlékezett, a bírálók szerint viszont elfedte a hatóságok felelősségét. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt kétharmados többséget szerzett.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-consolidation.english: In July 2014 the memorial on Szabadság tér was put up. According to the government the memorial commemorated the victims of the occupation; according to the critics, however, it concealed the responsibility of the authorities. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza Party won a two-thirds majority.
c1-emlekezetpolitika-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the main episodes of memory politics between 2010 and 2026, with years and sources.

c1-biroifuggetlenseg-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Retirement Age of Judges
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-01.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what the new judicial laws required from judges.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-01.prompt: Say what the rule required from judges from 2012 and how the government and its critics judged it.
cues: Say what judges were obliged to do
Name the source of each view
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-01.target: A hatvankettedik életévüket betöltött bírák kötelesek voltak nyugdíjba vonulni. A kormány indoklása szerint a korhatár a közszolgálat általános korhatárához igazodott, a bírálók szerint viszont sértette a bírák elmozdíthatatlanságának elvét.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-01.english: Judges who had reached the age of sixty-two were obliged to retire. According to the government's reasoning the age limit followed the general age limit of the civil service; according to the critics, however, it violated the principle of the irremovability of judges.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-01.canDo: I can describe what the judicial laws of 2011 required from judges and how the retirement age was judged (*Kúria, nyugdíjkorhatár, megbízatás*).

c1-biroifuggetlenseg-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The National Judicial Office
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-02.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked about the powers of the president of the National Judicial Office.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-02.prompt: Say who made the proposal for the appointment of judges and what the Constitutional Court did in July 2012.
cues: Say who made the proposal for appointments
Say what the Constitutional Court did in July 2012
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-02.target: A bírák kinevezésére az OBH elnöke tett javaslatot. 2012 végén az Alkotmánybíróság az Alaptörvény átmeneti rendelkezéseivel együtt megsemmisítette az elnök ügyáthelyezési jogkörét.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-02.english: The president of the Office made the proposal for the appointment of judges. In July 2012 the Constitutional Court annulled the president's power to transfer cases.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-02.canDo: I can describe the powers of the National Judicial Office and its president in 2012 and 2013, with the dates (*jogkör, kinevezés, ügyáthelyezés*).

c1-biroifuggetlenseg-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Applications for Court Leadership
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-03.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked about the applications for leading posts in the courts.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-03.prompt: Say what the president did although the judicial bodies had ranked the applicants, and what the National Judicial Council found in 2018.
cues: Set the president's decision against the ranking
Say what the Council found in 2018
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-03.target: Annak ellenére, hogy a bírói testületek rangsorolták a pályázókat, az elnök több pályázatot eredménytelennek nyilvánított. 2018-ban az OBT több határozatában megállapította, hogy az OBH elnöke megsértette a szabályokat.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-03.english: Although the judicial bodies had ranked the applicants, the president declared several applications unsuccessful. In 2018 the Council found in several resolutions that the president of the Office had broken the rules.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-03.canDo: I can describe the work of the National Judicial Council and the dispute over applications for court leadership (*pályázat, rangsorol, önigazgatás*).

c1-biroifuggetlenseg-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Procedures of the Union
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-04.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked about the European procedures on the rule of law.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-04.prompt: Say what the European Parliament decided on 12 September 2018 and what the Council decided during the conditionality procedure.
cues: Give the date and the decision of the Parliament
Say what the Council decided in December 2022
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-04.target: 2018. szeptember 12-én az Európai Parlament határozatot fogadott el a hetedik cikk szerinti eljárásról. A feltételességi eljárás során a Tanács 2022 decemberében a források egy részének felfüggesztéséről döntött.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-04.english: On 12 September 2018 the European Parliament adopted a resolution on the procedure under Article 7. During the conditionality procedure the Council decided in December 2022 to suspend part of the funds.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-04.canDo: I can describe the European procedures of 2018 to 2023 on the rule of law, with their dates (*határozat, feltételességi eljárás, felfüggeszt*).

c1-biroifuggetlenseg-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Amendments of 2023
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-05.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what was stated about the amendments of 2023.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-05.prompt: Report what the government stated about the amendments and what the Commission found in December 2023.
cues: Report the statement of the government
Report the finding of the Commission
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-05.target: A kormány azt közölte, hogy a módosítások az uniós feltételek teljesítését szolgálták. A Bizottság 2023 decemberében azt állapította meg, hogy a bírói függetlenséggel kapcsolatos feltételek teljesültek.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-05.english: The government stated that the amendments served the fulfilment of the Union's conditions. In December 2023 the Commission found that the conditions concerning judicial independence had been fulfilled.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-05.canDo: I can report what the government and the Commission stated about the amendments of 2023 (*módosítás, teljesül, felszabadít*).

c1-biroifuggetlenseg-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Period in Summary
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the period.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the period briefly, with years and sources.
cues: Mention the judicial laws of 2011
Mention the ruling of the European Union's Court of Justice
Mention the election of 2026
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-consolidation.target: 2011-ben az Országgyűlés új törvényeket fogadott el a bíróságokról. Az Európai Unió Bírósága 2012 novemberében megállapította, hogy a korhatár csökkentése sértette az uniós szabályokat. 2026. május 9-én az Országgyűlés Magyar Pétert választotta miniszterelnökké.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-consolidation.english: In 2011 the National Assembly adopted new laws on the courts. In November 2012 the Court of Justice of the European Union found that the lowering of the age limit violated the Union's rules. On 9 May 2026 the National Assembly elected Magyar Péter prime minister.
c1-biroifuggetlenseg-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the changes to the courts and the European procedures between 2011 and 2026, with years and sources.

c1-irodalmielet-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The National Core Curriculum
c1-irodalmielet-01.scenario: In a literature seminar you are asked about the National Core Curriculum of 2020.
c1-irodalmielet-01.prompt: Say when the new curriculum appeared and how its critics and the government judged it, naming the source.
cues: Give the date of the publication
Name the source of each view
c1-irodalmielet-01.target: 2020. január 31-én megjelent az új Nemzeti alaptanterv. Írók, tanárok és tanári szervezetek szerint a kortárs szerzők háttérbe szorultak, a kormány szerint viszont a tanterv a magyar irodalmi örökség átadását szolgálta.
c1-irodalmielet-01.english: On 31 January 2020 the new National Core Curriculum appeared. According to writers, teachers and teachers' organisations contemporary authors were pushed into the background; according to the government, however, the curriculum served the transmission of the Hungarian literary heritage.
c1-irodalmielet-01.canDo: I can describe the National Core Curriculum of 2012 and 2020 and its reading lists, with the dates (*kánon, alaptanterv, kötelező olvasmány*).

c1-irodalmielet-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Textbook System
c1-irodalmielet-02.scenario: In a literature seminar you are asked how the supply of textbooks changed after 2011.
c1-irodalmielet-02.prompt: Say what the critics said compared with the earlier system and what the government said the aim was.
cues: Compare with the earlier system
Give the aim stated by the government
c1-irodalmielet-02.target: A bírálók szerint a korábbi rendszerhez képest szűkült a tanárok és az iskolák választási lehetősége. A kormány szerint a változás célja az volt, hogy a diákok ingyenesen jussanak tankönyvhöz.
c1-irodalmielet-02.english: According to the critics, compared with the earlier system the freedom of choice of teachers and schools narrowed. According to the government, the aim of the change was that pupils should get textbooks free of charge.
c1-irodalmielet-02.canDo: I can describe how the supply of textbooks changed after 2011, with the dates (*tankönyvjegyzék, kiadó, választék*).

c1-irodalmielet-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Literary Institutions
c1-irodalmielet-03.scenario: In a literature seminar you are asked about the Petőfi Literary Museum.
c1-irodalmielet-03.prompt: Say who was appointed director-general in 2019 and what the critics said about the appointed leaders and the supported authors.
cues: Say who was appointed and when
Give the view of the critics
c1-irodalmielet-03.target: A Petőfi Irodalmi Múzeum főigazgatójává 2019-ben Demeter Szilárdot nevezték ki. A bírálók szerint a kinevezett vezetők és a támogatott szerzők köre a kormányhoz közel állókra szűkült.
c1-irodalmielet-03.english: In 2019 Demeter Szilárd was appointed director-general of the Petőfi Literary Museum. According to the critics, the circle of the appointed leaders and the supported authors narrowed to those close to the government.
c1-irodalmielet-03.canDo: I can describe the Hungarian Academy of Arts and the Petőfi Literary Museum in the years 2011 to 2019 (*akadémia, köztestület, főigazgató*).

c1-irodalmielet-04.title: Communicative Challenge: State and Independent Institutions
c1-irodalmielet-04.scenario: In a literature seminar you are asked how state and independent literary institutions differed.
c1-irodalmielet-04.prompt: Compare the Hungarian Academy of Arts with the Writers' Society within one sentence.
cues: Name what kind of body the Academy was
Name what kind of association the Writers' Society was
c1-irodalmielet-04.target: Míg a Magyar Művészeti Akadémia köztestület volt, a Szépírók Társasága önkéntes tagságú íróegyesületként működött. A Szépírók Társasága 2001-ben alakult.
c1-irodalmielet-04.english: While the Hungarian Academy of Arts was a public body, the Writers' Society worked as a voluntary association of writers. The Writers' Society was founded in 1989.
c1-irodalmielet-04.canDo: I can compare state and independent literary institutions in the 2010s (*íróegyesület, magánkiadó, független*).

c1-irodalmielet-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Open Questions and Recent Events
c1-irodalmielet-05.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked what was left open and what happened in 2025.
c1-irodalmielet-05.prompt: Name one open question of the canon debate and say who received the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2025.
cues: State one question that was disputed
Say who received the Nobel Prize and when
c1-irodalmielet-05.target: Vitatott volt, hogy kell-e kötelező szerzők listáját előírni. 2025 októberében Krasznahorkai László kapta az irodalmi Nobel-díjat.
c1-irodalmielet-05.english: It was disputed whether a list of compulsory authors should be prescribed. In October 2025 Krasznahorkai László received the Nobel Prize in Literature.
c1-irodalmielet-05.canDo: I can state the open questions of the canon debate before the election of 2026 (*jegyzék, szaktanár, előír*).

c1-irodalmielet-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Period in Summary
c1-irodalmielet-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the period.
c1-irodalmielet-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the period briefly, with years.
cues: Mention the curriculum of 2012
Mention the curriculum of 2020
Mention the election of 2026
c1-irodalmielet-consolidation.target: 2012-ben a kormány új Nemzeti alaptantervet fogadott el. 2020. január 31-én megjelent az új tanterv. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt kétharmados többséget szerzett.
c1-irodalmielet-consolidation.english: In 2012 the government adopted a new National Core Curriculum. On 31 January 2020 the new curriculum appeared. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza Party won a two-thirds majority.
c1-irodalmielet-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the main episodes of the debate about the literary canon between 2012 and 2026, with years and sources.
